**Best move:** Kd2

**Main line:** Kd2 Qxd1+ Kxd1

**Coaching Note (80 words):**
When you get checked, don't just move your king to safety—look for a bonus. Here, moving Kd2 escapes check AND unmasks your rook's attack on Black's undefended queen. Black is forced to capture your rook with check, but you recapture with your king, winning the queen outright (a 9-point gain). Always scan for discovered attacks when moving out of check; sometimes the escape square does double duty and turns a defensive move into a winning blow.
